config.showFinishedAgents: Display of finished or failed agents (and of workflows where nothing runs anymore): `always` (kept visible, dimmed), `temporarily` (hidden after the retention delay), `never` (active agents only).
config.finishedAgentRetentionSeconds: Delay (in seconds since last activity) before a finished or failed agent is hidden, in `temporarily` mode.
config.inactiveSessionRetentionMinutes: Delay (in minutes since last activity) before an inactive session is hidden. `0` = always show.
config.alwaysShowWorkspaceSessions: Keep the sessions of the open workspace visible whatever their inactivity (the delay above still applies to other projects).
config.showUsage: Show plan limits at the bottom of the view (reads the usage file below)
config.usageFile: Path to a JSON file holding the content of claude.ai/usage, kept up to date by your own tool
command.usageStatusBarMenu: Usage display in the status bar
config.usageStatusBar: Plan usage in the status bar: `text` (Session 2% 4:09:21 · Weekly 18% 3d 04h), `rings` (one ring per limit, figures on hover) or `off`. Needs `claudeAgents.usageFile`.
config.usageStatusBar.text: Percentage and countdown to the reset
config.usageStatusBar.rings: One ring per limit, figures on hover
config.usageStatusBarSide: Side of the status bar where the usage sits: `right` (at the far end) or `left`.
